It replaces the long combinational AccMath.requantizeQ31WithShift cone in the integer path with three existing five-stage LinearOutputRequantizer pipelines for Q/K/V. channelScale and activationScale are wired to 0x80000000 so the composed scale equals each q/k/v outputScale, preserving the original Q31 requantization semantics. A new sRequantDrain state waits for all Q/K/V lane captures before QKV emit. This adds five cycles of drain latency per emitted QKV beat; steady-state token issue is affected modestly by this pipeline latency and must be rolled into downstream cycle estimates. timing_source_repair.implementation_summary: Pipelined the IntegerVectorNorm emission cone that the Vivado path isolates from meanReg_reg to emitAffineProduct_reg. The previous emit FSM collapsed the centered subtraction, 127x numerator multiply, inverse-denominator multiply, and nearest-even round into a single registered stage. The edit splits that cone into discrete registered stages for centered value, scaled numerator, normalized product, rounding, affine gamma multiply, reciprocal multiply, and final beta/saturate. Arithmetic widths are preserved exactly as inferred from the current source ({32,40,65,65,130,149}); no constraints, false paths, multicycles, precision, ready/valid, token overlap, DDR weight behavior, active/shadow prefetch, external ABI, or reset behavior are changed. This adds three emitStage cycles per emitted beat, which changes LayerNorm serial emit latency from 7 cycles/beat (336 cycles/token) to 10 cycles/beat (480 cycles/token), increasing the nominal IntegerVectorNorm token interval from 641 cycles/token to 785 cycles/token and requiring schedule recalibration after timing rerun.
